Grab the mic. Grab your courage. Thee Liqour is hosting a night where YOU are the star — until a queen decides otherwise 🎤👑 This Thursday, Azucar turns into total chaos in the best way possible. Sing your heart out, belt the wrong notes, and just when you think you own the stage… a queen pops out mid-verse to steal the whole show. No cover, no excuses — just you, the mic, and a room full of people ready to hype you up (or lovingly roast you). Bring your dollars, bring your friends, bring the energy. This is the karaoke night Pasco's been missing. 🔥

📅 Thursday, August 13 — 8:00 PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free Entry
🔞 21+
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #DragQueenKaraoke #TheeLiqour #PascoNightlife #LatinxNightlife #DragPasco #KaraokeNight

Neon lights, glittering wigs, and a mic that never knows what's coming next 🎶✨ Picture it: you're mid-chorus, feeling unstoppable, when suddenly a queen in six-inch heels struts up and takes the whole verse from you. That's the vibe Thee Liqour brings every single time. The room smells like sweet perfume and spilled drinks, the bass thumps under your feet, and every song turns into a full-blown performance whether you asked for it or not. It's messy, it's glamorous, it's unforgettable. Azucar doesn't do quiet Thursdays — we do jaw-dropping, can't-look-away, tell-your-friends-about-it Thursdays. Come feel it for yourself. 💋🎤

Come exactly as you are — because tonight the whole room's about to sing off-key together anyway 🎤💜 Azucar has always been the spot where you don't need an invitation to belong, just your voice (however shaky) and your people beside you. Thee Liqour hosts this glorious mess of drag, karaoke, and pure chaos, and everyone's welcome to grab the mic. Shy at first? Doesn't matter — by the second song you'll be cheering for a stranger like family. This is Latinx community energy at its finest: loud, joyful, and a little unpredictable when a queen decides she's stealing your spotlight. No judgment, all love. Bring your crew and let's make some noise. 🔥👑
